# Pratik Mehta

> Personal portfolio of Pratik Mehta, a Creative Marketing Lead working across brand, social, content, UI/UX, motion, and performance as one connected system. Built on the One System brand. Based in New York. Open to creative or marketing roles.

## Site

- [Home](https://mehtapratik.com/): The practice, featured work, and how the pieces connect.
- [Work](https://mehtapratik.com/work): Full case-study index, filterable by engagement (in-house, agency, concept) and discipline.
- [About](https://mehtapratik.com/about): Career path from computer science through design into marketing, how Pratik works, the AI workflow, collaboration preferences, and influences.
- [Resume](https://mehtapratik.com/resume): Full work history, self-initiated systems, education, and tools.
- [Brand](https://mehtapratik.com/brand): The One System brand reference (tokens, type, logo, formats).
- [Journal](https://mehtapratik.com/journal): Notes on systems, brand, and AI.
- [Contact](https://mehtapratik.com/contact): Ways to get in touch.
- [Privacy](https://mehtapratik.com/privacy): Analytics and cookie policy.

## Work (case studies)

Each entry is labeled by engagement: the role Pratik held, not a client relationship.

- [Brands and organizations](https://mehtapratik.com/work#brands): the 30+ brands, partners, and organizations the work ran for or through, grouped by the role it ran through rather than listed flat.

### In-house (a role held inside the organization)

- [SPORTIME Clubs](https://mehtapratik.com/work/sportime-clubs): A video-first content engine across tennis, pickleball, and a $75M expansion. Marketing Manager.
- [Johnny Mac Tennis Project](https://mehtapratik.com/work/jmtp): Photography, video, and event production for SPORTIME's nonprofit, inside the SPORTIME role. Marketing Manager, SPORTIME.
- [DealNews](https://mehtapratik.com/work/dealnews): In-house social, paid, and design for an ecommerce deals brand. Social and Graphic Manager.
- [The Forest Road Company](https://mehtapratik.com/work/frc): Social direction, paid campaigns, and executive reporting for a media-finance firm. Social Media Director.
- [Pipeline Medical](https://mehtapratik.com/work/pipeline-medical): Brand and a B2B supplier marketplace built from zero, logo system through procurement screens. Designer (Internship).
- [SR Love and Care](https://mehtapratik.com/work/sr-love-and-care): Built, scaled, and handed off a volunteer marketing and design team for a humanitarian nonprofit. Marketing and Design Team Lead (Volunteer).

### Agency (a role at an agency, whose clients were other companies)

- [Richard Attias & Associates](https://mehtapratik.com/work/raa): Environmental, print, and digital production for the FII 2019 global forum. Associate Designer.
- [Agency FiveEighty](https://mehtapratik.com/work/agency-fiveeighty): Broadcast motion and title sequences for agency campaigns. Graphic and Motion Designer (Internship).

### Concept (self-initiated, never commissioned)

- [The Ninth](https://mehtapratik.com/work/the-ninth): Self-initiated esports membership concept, brand through product, with an AI moment-clipper prototype. Designed around a real global esports organization; unaffiliated, not commissioned, and not endorsed by it.
- [Level](https://mehtapratik.com/work/level): Self-initiated prediction-market concept built around responsible use and product trust. Its own invented brand, not a real product.
- [WISP](https://mehtapratik.com/work/wisp): Self-initiated concept for a faceless AI host presence. A scripted demonstration of an interaction model, not a live AI model.
- [Portfolio System](https://mehtapratik.com/work/portfolio-system): This site, as its own case study. Design system, front-end, and infrastructure built solo, then measured on itself: 100 desktop Lighthouse on every page.

## Notes

- "In-house" and "agency" describe the role Pratik held. None of this work was a client engagement, and the agency entries were roles at the agency: those clients were the agency's, not his.
- The brands list is grouped for that same reason. Naming an organization records that the work ran for or through it, never that Pratik held the client relationship. The independent practice group is the only set of direct engagements, and it is a practice, not an agency or a freelance shop.
- Self-initiated systems (The Ninth, Level, WISP, Portfolio System) are not professional work and were never commissioned. Each carries a visible non-affiliation disclosure.
- Every case study uses one proof shape: a verified metric where one was measured, scope and rationale where none exists. This is not decided by engagement type. The three design-only concepts carry scope; Portfolio System shipped and runs, so it carries measured results.
- Figures described as scope are counts of what was designed, never claims about audience, engagement, adoption, or revenue.
- Employment type (internship, volunteer) is stated in each case study's Role field.
